# ETF shares fixtures

`szse-current-20261013.xlsx` is the unmodified 72,392-byte snapshot supplied at
`/tmp/szse_etf.xlsx`, downloaded on 2026-10-13 from
https://fund.szse.cn/api/report/ShowReport?SHOWTYPE=xlsx&CATALOGID=1000_lf&TABKEY=tab1 .
It has `基金代码`, `当前规模(份)` and `上市日期`; it has **no report/as-of date**.
Its actual share amounts are preserved, but cannot be attributed to T-1.
The parser must reject it with `missing_report_date`, never use 上市日期.
SHA-256 is recorded in the implementation report.

All historical OOXML generated by tests is **synthetic**, including headers,
absolute share amounts, Excel serials and hostile ZIPs. No historical XLSX
original was supplied. Synthetic schemas exercise the restricted reader; they
do not establish actual historical source column names. The known 159659
10,000,000 difference is tested directly, without inventing historical totals.
